text:
zara: Quick thread for Friday's release notes — need final text for: SDK migration note, migration guide link, and a short known-issues item about streaming + quantization.
mike: I'll finish the Go snippets this morning. Anything special about error handling?
zara: Keep it tiny. Show `defer client.Close()` + minimal retry example. We want parity with Python/Node examples.
anya: I updated the migration guide to call out param renames: `sequence_length` -> `max_sequence` and `model_id` -> `model`. Put a short curl example in the guide.
li: Found two bad anchors after the layout change: `/docs/dedicated/old-cache` and `/docs/api/embeddings-v1`. Opening redirect PR now.
docs-bot: link-checker: 2 broken links -> ticket #834 created. Preview blocked until redirects merged.
zara: Li please add 301 redirects and a one-line note in the migration doc: "If you hit a 404, search for the new field names or follow redirects."
li: Will do. Also adding a tiny repro for the streaming truncation: run quantized model with long prefix > 2048 tokens reproduces truncated final token. Adding curl + example output.
evans: For changelog language, product prefers "superseded" instead of "deprecated" when referring to the old embeddings endpoint. Use short wording.
zara: Noted. Draft bullet: "Embeddings endpoint superseded; see migration guide (link)" — keep <80 chars.
mike: Go snippet draft below, please sanity-check: 

```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
defer client.Close()
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, "gpt-open-7b", redwood.GenerateParams{Prompt: "TL;DR"})
if err != nil { log.Fatalf("gen err: %v", err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

li: Looks good. Add a tiny comment about streaming vs non-streaming token counts.
anya: Also update the changelog line for SDK: "SDK: migration to client v2 (streaming API updated)" — marketing asked to add a link to the migration guide.
zara: I'll assemble the final list after redirects merge and CI preview passes. Plan: merge PRs by 2pm, run `make docs-build`, then post the release notes draft in #announcements for review.
docs-bot: deploy-preview started for docs/fix-migration-links-2026.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: failed -> error: unmatched fenced code block in docs/migrate/guide.md line 45.
li: My fault, missed closing triple backticks in the curl example. Pushing fix now.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: success -> preview at https://deploy-preview-158.docs.redwood.ai
mike: Local sanity-check complete. Snippets render and tests pass.
zara: Great. One more copy edit: change "sequence_length" mention in the migration guide to `max_sequence` (inline code) and add note: "Workaround: pin max_sequence=1024 for Dedicated until runtime patch".
anya: I'll add the known-issues blurb: short repro, impact (possible token truncation for quantized models), and a temporary workaround. Keep it factual and include curl snippet.
li: Redirect PR merged (#439). All snippet PRs green.
docs-bot: docs site build passed.
zara: Merging and scheduling announcement for tomorrow AM. Thanks all :tada:
